YOUR SAFETY MATTERS

Stay connected. Stay in control.

Trip-start PIN

Your driver must enter the six-digit PIN shown in your booking to start your journey. Never share it before checking the driver and vehicle.

Ladies rides

For verified women riders with a verified woman driver and an all-women travelling party. If none are available, we show no availability.

Share your journey

Create a revocable link from My trips. Driver location appears only while they share it. Links expire after two hours or when the trip ends.

Emergency help

The floating SOS button opens 112 calling, location sharing and your trusted contact. Opening SOS does not automatically contact police or send an alert.

Report a concern

Reports are stored for operator review. This is not a monitored emergency channel. Call 112 for immediate danger.
